about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Alzenins Language Centre — founded in 2020 as Arab Quoshi.
about.journeyBody: Since 2020 we have been building courses and learning experiences that help people develop real skills and actually use them.
about.philosophyBody: We believe learning should be flexible, contemporary and grounded in reality. Our programmes combine simplicity, quality and genuine interaction.
about.pathBody: We have produced varied training content and shared what we know through meetups, podcasts and digital material.
about.visionBody: We are aiming past the traditional course — towards a space for learning, inspiration and exchanging experience.
about.closing: Our journey continues… and the best hasn't started yet.
